Everything to get started - claim and bond a horse, read its stats, ride smarter, and how breeding and coats work.
The five horse classes, the breeds inside each, and what every one of them can do.
Every craft in the mod, with a note on when each piece is worth making.

A JSON config at **config/icys-better-horses.json** toggles whole systems without removing the mod - admins use it to set what a world allows.   
    
With **Cloth Config** installed you can edit the same settings in game.

Every key takes **yes** or **no**:   
    
- **stabilizer** - gliding descent.   
- **medkit** - auto-heal on low health.   
- **hooves** - frost-walk, step-up, and fall-damage perks.   
- **horse_exclusivity** - owner-only riding.   
- **multiriding** - two riders on one horse.
Disabled items don't vanish - they drop to **dummy mode**, still craftable but purely decorative. Nothing fires, but you can still build a display stable.
Press your **Horse Whistle** key while mounted for a full profile of the horse you're riding. Unmounted, the same key whistles your nearby mount.

- **Gender** and **Breed** (with a **(mix)** tag if cross-bred).   
- **Coat** - color plus markings.   
- **Bond** - value out of 100 with a fill bar.   
- **Speed** - blocks per second.   
- **Jump** - block height.   
- **Health** - hit points.

Each bar fills toward the mod's ceiling, not this horse's own range:   
    
- Speed up to **26.25 blk/s**.   
- Jump up to **9.71 blk**.   
- Health up to **50 HP**.   
    
Speed and jump ceilings include the full-bond bonus, so a strong horse reads short until it's bonded. Health does not grow with bond.
An owned horse only answers to you - anyone else taking the reins is bucked off at once. It will still take a second rider, but only while you're in the saddle.

**/horse trust PlayerName** lets one player ride on their own. It covers every horse you own, now and later; **/horse untrust** takes it back.   
    
See **Trusted Riders** for what that hands over.
Set **horse_exclusivity** to **no** in the config and any player can ride any owned horse - handy for shared stables.
Tame a horse fully and it becomes **owned** and starts using Better Horses' systems.

Look at an owned horse and press your **Horse Command Wheel** key. Pick a wedge, or click outside to cancel.   
    
- **Follow**: it trails after you.   
- **Wander**: grazes and roams a 32x32 area around where you gave the order.   
- **Stay**: it waits where you left it.   
- **Set Home**: marks the spot as home and switches to Stay.   
- **Return Home**: sends it back to that spot.

Press **Horse Whistle** and nearby mounts switch to **Follow**; distant ones are pulled closer. Mounted, the same key opens the info screen.   
    
Bond runs 0 to 100, and every 20 points adds speed and jump.   
    
- Stay near your horse for slow passive gain.   
- A **Name Tag** gives +10 bond.   
- A **Golden Apple** gives +2 bond.

**/horse trust PlayerName** lets that player ride every horse you own.   
    
Trust is stored per player, not per horse, so it covers every horse you tame later - you never run it again for a new mount.

A trusted rider is treated as you are: mounting, riding pillion, driving a cart, the gear screen, saddlebags and cart chest, fitting gear, shearing and commands.   
    
The one thing they **cannot** do is disown it. Releasing a horse stays with its owner.

**/horse untrust PlayerName** revokes it, bucking them off on the spot if they're riding.   
    
**/horse trusted** lists everyone you trust.   
    
A trusted rider can ride your horse away and you can't whistle it back. Only trust people you'd hand a lead to.
Better Horses turns an ordinary mount into a lasting companion: ownership, bonding, and a stack of riding fixes. This book covers all of it.
Tame a horse and it's registered to you at once. From there you can bond with it, equip it, and command it.

Press **Manage Horses** for the roster - every horse registered to you, wherever it is.   
    
A horse marked **Resting** is in an unloaded chunk. It's safe, and still answers the whistle.

Pick a horse and it appears in 3D on the right, so you can tell them apart.   
    
Three lines sit under the model:   
    
- Its **coordinates**, as X, Y, Z.   
- Its **bond**, out of 100.   
- Whether it has a **home** set.

The fastest way to fetch a mount too far off to whistle, or resting in another dimension.   
    
Nearby, the numbers follow it as it moves. Resting, they're the last spot it stood - exactly where you'll find it. Always in that horse's own dimension, shown beside its gender.

- **Set Active** - the horse your whistle calls from now on.   
- **Whistle** - calls it to you; it walks if it's close, teleports if it isn't.   
- **Send Home** - packs it off to its saved home.   
- **Disown** - gives it up for good, after a confirmation. Strip its gear first.

Bold patchwork coats with dramatic **white field** patterns.   
    
Speed: **8-15** blk/s   
Jump: **2-4** blk   
Health: **15-30**

**At bond 0:** A map filled from the saddle covers twice the usual ground.   
    
**At bond 40:** Three times.   
    
**At bond 100:** Four times, and structures it rides past get marked - modded ones included.

An agile Iberian breed with a thick mane, common on open meadows.   
    
Speed: **9-15** blk/s   
Jump: **2-5** blk   
Health: **25-40**

**At bond 0:** The rider takes reduced damage while mounted.   
    
**At bond 40:** That reduction gets stronger.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Second Chance**: a killing blow is taken by the horse instead, which survives on one heart. Long cooldown.

Tough and athletic, and the only breed whose coat always carries **dots**.   
    
Speed: **8-15** blk/s   
Jump: **2-4** blk   
Health: **15-30**

**At bond 0:** Night vision while you ride it in the dark, no torch needed.   
    
**At bond 40:** **Herding**: with an empty hand, livestock within **20 blocks** trail the horse and keep up at a trot or canter. Pause it per horse from the command wheel.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Auto-feed**: with a chest on, it feeds livestock within **12 blocks** the right breeding food from its storage.

Compact and hardy - bred for desert crossings and badlands runs.   
    
Speed: **11-15** blk/s   
Jump: **3-5.5** blk   
Health: **15-20**

**At bond 0:** Speed builds while you move, to +10%% after twenty seconds. Stopping bleeds it off at 2%% a second.   
    
**At bond 40:** The ceiling doubles to +20%%.   
    
**At bond 100:** Ceiling in twelve seconds, with a two second grace so a brief pause no longer wipes it.

Belgium's draft breed and the strongest horse here - broader than a Percheron, heavily feathered, and built to pull rather than carry.   
    
Speed: **7-10** blk/s   
Jump: **1-3** blk   
Health: **35-50**

**At bond 0:** Six rows of storage, two above any other draft and the biggest chest in the mod.   
    
**At bond 40:** Seats three riders, as long as it is not carrying a chest.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Brick Break**: at a gallop it punches a **three-wide, three-tall** hole through weak blocks, but only through walls three or more tall - lower obstacles get stepped over. Costs health, half a minute to recover.

Scotland's draft giant and the showiest of the four - a parade horse before a ploughing one.   
    
Speed: **7-10** blk/s   
Jump: **1-3** blk   
Health: **35-50**

**At bond 0:** Barding grants **25%% more armour**, and charge and kick damage read armour too.   
    
**At bond 40:** Wearing barding grants the rider Resistance.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Deflect**: arrows and other projectiles are stopped before they land, off the horse **and off its rider**.

The all-black horse of the Dutch lowlands - tall, powerful, always show-ready.   
    
Speed: **9-15** blk/s   
Jump: **2-5** blk   
Health: **25-40**

**At bond 0:** Neutral mobs lose interest in you, and anything already angry drops the grudge.   
    
**At bond 40:** The same calm extends to hostile mobs.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Dressage**: rear the horse and every hostile in front is thrown back and loses its target.

A small Tyrolean breed, chestnut with a flaxen mane, sure-footed on slopes.   
    
Speed: **8-13** blk/s   
Jump: **2-4** blk   
Health: **25-40**

**At bond 0:** Four rows of storage, a row more than a pony deserves.   
    
**At bond 40:** Pulls a cart at full speed, normally a draft's job.   
    
**At bond 100:** Six rows, level with the Belgian, plus **Hearthlight**: after dark it glows and lights the ground it crosses.

A short, shaggy pony from Iceland with an unusually smooth extra gait.   
    
Speed: **8-13** blk/s   
Jump: **2-4** blk   
Health: **25-40**

**At bond 0:** Soul sand, cobwebs, berries and honey do not slow it, and berry bushes draw no blood from it or its rider.   
    
**At bond 40:** **Winter Coat**: neither horse nor rider freezes.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Clear Head**: poison, wither and hunger are refused outright - on the pony always, and on you while you ride.

A compact American breed, at home on the trail or in the field.   
    
Speed: **8-15** blk/s   
Jump: **2-4** blk   
Health: **15-30**

**At bond 0:** Bonds **half again as fast** as any other horse. Time near you, golden apples and name tags all count for more.   
    
**At bond 40:** That climbs to **double**.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Adaptable**: a slice of every other class at once, including a fourth storage row and a higher step.

Free-roaming and weatherproof, and rarely the same coat twice.   
    
Speed: **9-15** blk/s   
Jump: **2-5** blk   
Health: **25-40**

**At bond 0:** Nearby hostiles are outlined and the horse snorts a warning. It also heals itself without food - **a heart every 15 seconds**.   
    
**At bond 40:** Its healing climbs to **a heart every 8 seconds**, and it starts healing **you** too - **a heart every 10 seconds** in the saddle.   
    
**At bond 100:** Rider healing doubles to **a heart every 5 seconds**.

A French draft breed - heavy and muscular, but graceful for its size.   
    
Speed: **7-10** blk/s   
Jump: **1-3** blk   
Health: **35-50**

**At bond 0:** Soul sand, cobwebs, berries and honey do not slow it, and berry bushes draw no blood from it or its rider.   
    
**At bond 40:** **Momentum**: the longer it runs straight, the harder its charge lands - up to half again at full wind.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Chain Charge**: a charge that kills leaves no cooldown, so it can run straight through a group.

Stocky and broad-chested - a ranch horse, very fast over short distances.   
    
Speed: **11-15** blk/s   
Jump: **3-5.5** blk   
Health: **15-20**

**At bond 0:** Stand still for a second, then move off, and you get +30%% for 5 seconds. Ten second cooldown.   
    
**At bond 40:** The burst climbs to +45%%.   
    
**At bond 100:** Cooldown drops to 8 seconds.

England's largest draft horse - taller than a Clydesdale, just as patient, and feathered on all four legs.   
    
Speed: **7-10** blk/s   
Jump: **1-3** blk   
Health: **35-50**

**At bond 0:** Anything that has locked on but not yet swung gets snorted at and usually thinks better of it. Once it has hit you, it is too late.   
    
**At bond 40:** The radius widens.   
    
**At bond 100:** **Brick Break**, as the Belgian: a **three-wide, three-tall** hole through weak blocks, walls three or more tall only.

The classic racing horse - tall, lean, and an easy first pick for long rides.   
    
Speed: **11-15** blk/s   
Jump: **3-5.5** blk   
Health: **15-20**

**At bond 0:** +35%% speed for 3 seconds whenever you gallop on level ground, no wind-up, then 5 seconds before it fires again.   
    
**At bond 40:** The burst climbs to +50%%.   
    
**At bond 100:** The burst lasts 5 seconds, so you are boosted about half the time.
The heavy tier. Slowest legs, most hearts, worst jump, and the only horses that will carry a chest and two riders at the same time.

Four rows of storage as standard.   
A chest **and** two riders, which no other class allows.   
Pulls a loaded cart at full speed - every other class drags at -30%%.   
Heavy knockback resistance.   
Charge damage 1.25x, knockback 2x, the hardest in the game.   
Spooks at half the usual rate.
Small, stubborn and much harder to kill than they look. Ponies go places the big breeds physically cannot.

Steps **two full blocks** without jumping, where every other horse steps one.   
No fall damage under 15 blocks.   
Walks on powder snow with no hoof gear.   
Heals slowly on its own, without food.   
Charge and kick damage 0.75x, with a race horse's light knockback.   
Standard spook chance.

The fastest legs in the stable on a single row of hearts - highest jump, softest charge.   
    
All three get their speed a different way, so the ground you ride decides which one wins.

Fastest speed and highest jump of any class.   
Lowest health in the game.   
Charge and kick damage 0.6x, the weakest.   
Standard spook chance.

Every horse belongs to one of five classes. The class sets the range its speed, health and jump roll from, plus perks shared by every breed in it.   
    
The breed decides your one unique ability, which grows at **bond 40** and again at **bond 100**.
The horses you take somewhere dangerous. Nearly the toughest in the game, and the only ones that will not panic on you.

**Never spook**, at any bond level.   
Never rear when struck, so you keep your seat and your heading.   
Medkits last twice as long.   
Charge and kick damage 1.5x, the highest.

Stock horses, built for ground you have already worked. Give them a road and they pick up speed on it.   
    
Health and pace sit close to an ordinary horse. What you are buying is everything around the riding.

+10%% speed on roads, rising to +20%% at bond 40 and +50%% at bond 100.   
Roads means paths, gravel, cobble, brick and anything tagged `horse_road`.   
Standard damage and spook chance.
A small copper-and-gold capsule. The harness can't be built without it, and a spent harness runs on it.
Think of the canister as the working end of the Glidewing Harness. Craft a few before building the rig, then keep spares: one canister on an **Anvil** refuels a spent harness by **80%**.
Two **Wheels**, a row of planks for the bed, and two slabs on top. Make the wheels first.

Slot the cart into the **Upgraded Saddle** and it rolls along behind your horse. It shares the harness slot, so a horse carries one or the other.   
    
Quickest way: right-click the horse holding the cart, as long as it wears an Upgraded Saddle and that slot is empty.

Right-click the ground to stand a cart up on its own, shafts down, no horse needed. A parked cart is decoration, but a **Chest** works on it as on a hitched one.   
    
Hit it a few times to pick it up, like a boat. Break one with a chest fitted and the chest and its contents drop too.

A small cart seats four: two on the driver's bench, first up drives, and two in the bed. The large cart carries **six**, four in the bed.   
    
Animals climb into the bed on their own, and one can ride shotgun beside you. The cart takes anything a **boat** would.   
    
**Sneak** and right-click an animal to set it down, or the cart to unload the lot.

Right-click the cart with a **Chest** to mount it in the bed. **Sneak** and right-click to open it: a full **double chest** on the small one, **ninety** slots on the large.   
    
A chest fills a small bed, so no back-seat passengers - the driver's bench still seats two. The large cart keeps two of its four bed seats.

Right-click the small cart with any **hoe** to drop a plough behind the bed. Drive over grass, dirt, coarse or rooted dirt, podzol or mycelium and it turns a **three-wide** strip to farmland in one pass. It reaches a block above the furrow, so a step up still gets turned.   
    
The hoe loses a point per block and takes the plough with it when it breaks, so bring a good one - **enchantments count**.   
    
**Shears** take it back off, plough before chest. Only the small cart takes one.

**Shears** take the chest off and drop it beside the horse. Empty it first - a loaded chest refuses.   
    
Things come off in the order they went on, and the slot flashes **red** if you skip a step: chest, then cart, then saddle.
Copper ingots and a leather strap, for a steadier step in rough country.
Horseshoes cross powder snow instead of falling through, and soften fall damage. Everyday tack for mountains and cold biomes.
Horseshoes take **Frost Walker** at an **Anvil** from an enchanted book. A horse running over water then leaves a trail of **frosted ice**, like a player wearing frost-walker boots.
Freeze radius follows the **Frost Walker level**. The trail samples the horse's movement, so fast horses can't outrun it. Lava still isn't safe.
Emergency tack: wool, healing supplies and a regeneration potion.
If a hit would drop your horse below half health, the medkit is spent and grants **Regeneration**, **Instant Health**, **Resistance** and **Fire Resistance**.
Bind your canisters into the full harness and mount it on the upgraded saddle.

Built for ravines and cliffs. On a big fall it deploys, slows the descent, and can cancel fall damage entirely.   
    
Right-click the horse holding it to fit, as long as it wears an Upgraded Saddle with that slot empty. Horses only - mules, donkeys and the undead sort can't wear one.(I'm too lazy to make seperate models)

The harness holds about **2 minutes** of gliding. It wears down only while it's open, and a gauge beside your hotbar shows what's left.   
    
Run it dry and it stays on the horse but won't deploy. Refuel it on an **Anvil** with a **Canister**: one canister restores **80%**. Nothing else repairs it.
Every craft in the tack room, gathered here for a quick reference.
Any **Better Horses** item plus a **Book** makes a fresh handbook.
Keep one in your travel chest and one at home. Cheap to remake.
The core of the tack room: a vanilla **Saddle**, copper and a few diamonds.
Equipped, it opens four gear slots: **Chest**, **Horseshoe**, **Medkit** and **Glidewing**. Most of the mod starts here.
A plain **Chest** gives 27 storage slots on the horse screen. Empty it before removing, or the contents drop.
An **Ender Chest** instead makes those 27 slots your **Ender Inventory**, shared with every ender chest you own. Swapping back keeps the contents.

Hold the **Upgraded Saddle** and look at a horse for a **Horse Stats** panel above your hotbar:   
    
- **Gender**   
- **Breed**   
- **Speed** - blocks per second   
- **Jump** - block height   
    
Handy for checking wild stock before taming.
Sticks for spokes, planks for rim and hub - any wood. Two make a cart.
A wheel alone does little. Two, with planks and slabs, make a **Horse Cart**.
Two horses of the same gender won't mate - you'll be told so, the apple is still spent, and love mode resets.

When a foal is born:   
    
- **Gender** is a coin flip.   
- **Breed** comes from one parent at 50/50. Matching parents pass it cleanly; different breeds give the foal a **(mix)** tag.   
- Cross-species pairs (horse + donkey) give the matching species placeholder.
Health, speed and jump are **max(parent1, parent2) + delta**, delta rolling **-0.5** to **+1.0**. Foals can beat both parents, but the vanilla base is the ceiling.

The coat always comes from the palette the inherited breed allows. Two **Quarter** horses give a Quarter pattern; a mixed pair can throw either side's palette.   
    
Which coat is a coin flip: **half** the time it wears a parent's coat, the other half one **neither parent wears** - so two black Shires often throw a bay or a roan.

Beyond **Bond**, every horse carries four pieces of identity:   
    
- **Gender** - male or female, donkeys and mules included.   
- **Breed** - one of fifteen real breeds; a species label for donkeys, mules and skeleton or zombie horses.   
- **Mixed-Breed** - a **(mix)** tag when a foal inherits two breeds.   
- **Coat** - color and markings, tied to the breed.

Press **Horse Whistle** while mounted for the **Horse Info Screen** - gender, breed, coat and stat bars. Holding the **Upgraded Saddle** and looking at a horse also shows gender and breed under its name.
A ridden horse should feel responsive. Better Horses fixes the small frictions vanilla horses had.

- Step height is raised a tenth, so a gallop doesn't trip on slabs, paths or full blocks.   
- Mounted block-breaking matches on-foot speed for most blocks.   
- Any penalty left is cut to a fifth.
Mounting no longer snaps your camera - the **horse turns to match you**. Standing still, you get **90 degrees** of free look before it follows, so you can scan the horizon without dismounting.
A **Saddle** (vanilla or upgraded) on a horse in **Creative** tames it instantly, no waiting on hearts.

- Two players can share one horse.   
- The first rider keeps the reins.   
- The second gets a back seat.
Double-tap **W** to auto-ride: the horse keeps moving and you just steer. Tap a movement key to take back control.

- They float instead of sinking in water.   
- They cross water faster.   
- Leaves lose collision while you ride, so forests feel like a path.

Press **Horse Walk Cycle** while riding to shift up a gait: **Walk**, **Trot**, **Canter**, **Gallop**, then halt. The current one prints over your hotbar.   
    
Once set, the horse holds the gait. You steer, and never touch **W**.

- **Walk** - about **2** blk/s.   
- **Trot** - about **4.4** blk/s.   
- **Canter** - about **6.8** blk/s.   
- **Gallop** - the horse's own top speed.   
    
The first three are set paces - a plough horse and a racer walk side by side. Only the gallop shows what a fast horse is worth, and a slower horse just gives you all it has.

Hold **W** or **S** and the gait steps aside until you let go, then picks up where it was. One press past **Gallop** halts.   
    
Cruise clears the gait outright, as does dismounting or changing horse.

A horse at a full **gallop** in a straight line is a weapon - whatever you steer into takes the hit, with no swing of your own.   
    
It arms after about **a second** straight and keeps building for **three**. Turning sharply or stopping resets it; slower straight movement and jumps keep it building.   
    
Only on the ground, with a rider, at a true gallop - free riding or the **Gallop** gait.

A meter beside your hotbar fills as the charge winds up. Full means the next thing you touch gets all of it; after a hit it refills over about **five seconds**. A **Percheron** at bond 100 skips that wait whenever its charge kills.

Base hit **7**, scaled by class: **War** 1.5x, **Draft** 1.25x, **Western** 1x, **Pony** 0.75x, **Race** 0.6x.   
    
- **Horse armor** adds up to **3**; a **Clydesdale** gets up to **5**.   
- Speed and wind-up near double it on a long straight run.   
- Nothing lands harder than **30**.   
    
Draft horses throw a target furthest, war horses next. Light classes barely shift it.

A fight your horse picks isn't always one it can win. **Horse Whistle** breaks off every horse you own that's fighting or bolting.   
    
They don't trot back - they run for about **three seconds**, which is the point: it pulls a horse out from under something far too big. Whistle again once they're clear.

The charge spares everything you'd rather keep:   
    
- You, and anyone riding with you.   
- Players you **trust**.   
- Other horses you own.   
- Anything allied to you or to the horse.   
    
The rest of the field in front of the horse is fair game.

Come at a horse from behind and it kicks, on the same class multiplier as the charge. Owned or wild, saddled or loose, they all do it.   
    
Its owner, anyone they trust, and whoever is in the saddle never take one. After kicking, a horse not already defending someone bolts for about three seconds.

When something hurts you, every horse you own within **16 blocks** knows.   
    
A loose horse at **bond 40** or better runs your attacker down. It breaks off under a third health, or if the fight drags **32 blocks** from where it started. A horse told to **Stay** stays.

The horse under you reacts the other way: it may panic and throw you off.   
    
The odds drop as it learns to trust you - **10%%**, **7%%** at bond 40, **5%%** at bond 100. **Draft** horses spook half as often, **War** horses never. It won't dump you in midair or over a drop.   
    
Charge, kick and defence are one switch: set **horse_combat** to **no** in the config.

Fit a cart to a **draft** horse and you get the big one, a covered wagon on four wheels. Every other class pulls the small two-wheeled cart.   
    
Look at the horse or cart and press **Swap Cart Size** to change either way, any time. Parked carts too.   
    
Only drafts may go large, and a cart refuses if its passengers or load wouldn't fit the new bed, or a parked one has no room to grow.

The big wagon has a roof. Zombies, skeletons and other undead riding in it **won't burn in daylight**, so it's a safe way to haul a zombie villager home for curing.   
    
The small cart is open to the sky, so anything riding in it burns as usual.

Press **Rear Horse** to put a horse on its hind legs - the one you're riding, or one you're looking at within **12 blocks**.   
    
It must be yours or one whose owner trusts you, and it ignores you while someone else holds the reins.   
    
Purely for show. A horse also rears when struck, costing you a moment's steering, though a **War** horse never does.

Better Horses brings its own advancements. Tame your first horse and the tree opens up.   
    
None of it is required - it's a checklist for a long life in the saddle.

- **Hold Your Horses** - tame a horse.   
- **Stable Reading** - get hold of this book.   
- **All Tacked Up** - craft the Upgraded Saddle.   
- **Home Is Where the Hay Is** - set a horse's home.   
- **Hell on Hooves** - take a horse to the Nether.   
- **Foal Play** - breed two horses.   
- **Best of Both Worlds** - raise a mixed-breed foal.

- **Ride or Die** - reach 100 bond.   
- **Built Different** - ride at 25 blk/s.   
- **Second Chance** - let an Andalusian take a killing blow for you.   
- **Pegasus, Sort Of** - survive a 30 block drop on a Glidewing Harness.   
- **Pocket Dimension, Four Legs** - fit an ender chest.   
- **Stable Genius** - own ten horses at once.   
- **Gotta Tame 'Em All** - own all fifteen breeds.
